from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class InstitutionMetric(BaseModel):
    institution_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the university")
    first_year_degree_seeking_students: int | None = Field(description="Number of enrolled first-time, first-year degree-seeking students")
    total_undergraduate_population: int | None = Field(description="Total undergraduate population")
    total_all_students: int | None = Field(description="Grand total of all students")
    full_time_instructional_faculty: int | None = Field(description="Number of full-time instructional faculty")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="Academic year or reporting period of the data")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    institutions: list[InstitutionMetric]
